answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 46641 Country: India Title: Sawm Question: I want to ask if I ejaculate during fast by own will my fast remain intact? What I have to do now? Answer ID: 46641 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1003/764/D=1434) Your fast shall nullify and qaza shall be wajib. However, no kaffarah (expiation) shall be wajib due to it. And this practice is makrooh tahrimi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
